lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A transition from discrete spots to a labyrinthine, vermiculated pattern of thin high-luminance lines is observed on the dorsal surface of the head anterior to the gills.
